title: Samsung Galaxy A70s Unboxing & First Look - The Camera Monster :fire::fire::fire:
description: Namaskaar dosto, is video mein maine aapse baat ki hai samsung ke brand new a series ke baare mein, galaxy a series mein samsung ne abhi ek naya phone launch kiya hai galaxy a70s. Maine aapse is video mein samsung galaxy a70s ki unboxing aur first look share kiya hai jaha is phone mein hai 6.7 "ka ek fhd+ super amoed display hai, infinity u cut ke saath mein, Qualcomm Snapdragon 675 Octacore Processor. The Triple Rear Camera 64MP + 8MP Ultrawide Ka Aur Infinity U Design Jaha Hai 32MP Ka Front Facing Camera Super Fast Charging Ka Support Bhi Awailable Hai. Samsung Galaxy Aapko 6GB/8GB Ram + 128GB Storage Milti Hai, Saath Hi Galaxy Aapko Ek Tripko ek triple Slot Milot Milot Milta Milta Milling Aur Sim cards ke liye aur saath mein usb-c port hai charging ke liye, galaxy a70s mein mst based samsung pay ka option bhi milta hai. Aur first look video pasand aayegi.   Galaxy a70s price:  6GB + 128GB - 28,999inr 8GB + 128GB - 30,999inr   Share, support, subscribe !!!
